symptom: `mxcli marketplace package` refused to export when another Mendix version's mx was on PATH although the project's exact mx was cached (the hint said to take it off PATH), and `--mxbuild-path` naming a folder without an mx exported with the PATH mx under the override
cause: the version check (checkMxVersion) ran after docker.ResolveMxForVersion, which tries PATH before an exact-version install and falls back to PATH when --mxbuild-path holds no mx
fix: packageMxPath takes docker.LocalMxForVersion first without --mxbuild-path, and refuses an mx outside the named path with it (pathWithin, shared with git merge); the help text and hint say so
insight: same defect, same fix as git merge (ako/mxcli#2644): the version check must follow an exact-version lookup, not a preference-ordered resolver. Any other writer that checks ResolveMxForVersion's result after the fact has the hole too
